title: local web service for pebble always returns 0 for iob
symptom: The local web service endpoint http://127.0.0.1:17580/pebble always returns 0 for iob, while the corresponding Nightscout URL returns the correct iob value. The user wants to use the local service to get iob data for a Fitbit Versa watchface, especially when without internet.
cause: xDrip only calculates its simulation IoB when the main graph is displayed as it is quite CPU intensive. The local web service's pebble endpoint had iob hardcoded to 0.
fix: A pull request (https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/2897) was submitted and merged that implements IoB reporting in the /pebble endpoint.
evidence_quote: I've submitted a PR that implements this functionality: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/2897
